title: Assertion: Toggles Every 4 Cycles
constraints: Rule: after `q` changes, it must stay stable for exactly 3 more cycles and change again on the 4th (a divide-by-8 clock).
The first change after reset starts the pattern. Before it, q may stay constant.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: `$changed(q)` is true in the cycle where q differs from its previous sample.
Both 'too early' and 'too late' toggles must fail.
